name: io.github.assaf/expense
title: Expense
description: Personal expense tracking for tax season, driven by your AI assistant: capture receipts from photos and PDFs (OCR + categorization from your own history), log map-based mileage at the IRS rate, answer "how much did I spend on X?" from your actual data, build and export expense reports, and reconcile bank statements. OAuth sign-in with your account — no API keys.
